description: Explicit, specification-driven variable construction from a validated/harmonized dataset. V1 supports ONLY safe declarative structured expressions (NO arbitrary eval / arbitrary expression execution): arithmetic (add/subtract/multiply/divide over columns or scalars), log (natural/base-10, domain-guarded), ratio/share (denominator non-zero), difference and growth_rate (panel+time ordered), interaction (product of >=2 declared terms), lag/lead (panel_by+time_by, duplicate unit-time key fails), and indicator/eligibility FLAG (structured predicate; computed only as a flag, NEVER applied to the final estimation sample). It NEVER autonomously decides sample exclusion / treatment / which observations enter the estimation sample; it never imputes, winsorizes, deletes outliers, or constructs treatment/exposure by itself. Sample exclusion and treatment definition remain Director/study-design decisions.

references.name: DIME Data Handbook (World Bank) - data management / documentation / reproducibility
DIME Wiki - Data Management (deduplication, documentation, data cleaning discipline)

methodology.note: Declarative, deterministic, auditable variable construction. Consumes a frozen dataset + an explicit Domain construct plan (structured expression spec). No arbitrary expression execution; domain guards (log/ratio/growth) and panel-time ordering enforced; sample boundary preserved (flag only).

verification.evidence: M2 implementation + closure: Python/pandas safe declarative construction against a frozen synthetic panel; verifies declared input SHA256 (raw-byte; source mutation fails closed); applies only declared structured operations (arithmetic/log/ratio/difference/growth_rate/interaction/lag/lead/indicator) in authoritative order; deterministic output + machine-readable execution log (plan_sha256, input/output raw-byte SHA256, rows before/after, per-op input/output/structural_missing, domain/divide-zero evidence, warnings/errors). Closure: log missingness propagates deterministically (non-missing x<=0 fails log_domain_violation; missing never converted to invalid); ordered dependency graph validated (no future-output reference, no cycle, unique op_id/target, target must not collide with input column, periods must be positive integer, predicate AND/OR strictly binary, scientific_role requires an approved scientific_decision binding). Frozen evidence: deterministic synthetic construct benchmark (all 9 ops) PASS; adversarial + provenance/tamper suite PASS (divide-by-zero, log zero/negative, output collision, missing input var, duplicate unit-time key, lag/lead missing ordering, growth zero lag denominator, invalid periods, arbitrary expression/eval, dependency cycle, future-output reference, sample-exclusion rejected, undeclared treatment rejected, source mutation, plan/order mutation, deterministic rerun, execution-log tamper). Does NOT impute/winsorize/delete-outliers/decide-sample-exclusion/define-treatment/apply eligibility flag; NO arbitrary eval. NOT tested; NOT verified; experimental.
